import networkx as nx
import numpy as np
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit, transpile, assemble
from qiskit_optimization import QuadraticProgram
from qiskit_optimization.algorithms import QAOA
from qiskit_optimization.converters import QuadraticProgramToQubo
from qiskit.circuit.library import ZZFeatureMap
from qiskit.transpiler import PassManager
from qiskit_aer import AerSimulator
from qiskit_aer.noise import NoiseModel
from qiskit_aer.noise import pauli_errors
from qiskit_aer.noise import pauli_depolarizing_error
from qiskit_aer.noise import depolarizing_error
from qiskit_optimization.algorithms import SimulatedAnnealing
from qiskit_optimization.converters import LinearFunction
from qiskit_optimization.algorithms import OptimizationResult
from dwave.system import DWaveSampler
from dwave.embedding import embed_ising
from dwave.embedding import chain_break_reinsertion

def create_graph_and_edges(graph_vertices, graph_edges):
    # Create a graph from the given vertices and edges
    G = nx.Graph()
    G.add_nodes_from(graph_vertices)
    G.add_weighted_edges_from(graph_edges)
    return G

def create_quadratic_program(G):
    # Create a QuadraticProgram from the graph
    qp = QuadraticProgram("Max Cut")

    # Add variables
    for node in G.nodes():
        qp.binary_var(name=f"x{node}")

    # Add constraints
    for edge in G.edges():
        qp.linear_constraint(LinearFunction([1, 1], [0, 0], "<=", [edge[0], edge[1]]), name=f"edge_{edge[0]}_{edge[1]}")

    # Add objective
    for edge in G.edges():
        qp.quadratic_constraint(QuadraticFunction([edge[0], edge[1]], [1, -1], [1, 1]), name=f"edge_{edge[0]}_{edge[1]}")

    return qp

def qaoa_max_cut(G):
    qp = create_quadratic_program(G)

    # Convert QuadraticProgram to QUBO
    qubo = QuadraticProgramToQubo()
    qubo_problem = qubo.convert(qp)

    # Create a QAOA instance
    qaoa = QAOA(optimizer=SimulatedAnnealing(), reps=3, initial_state=ZZFeatureMap(feature_dimension=G.number_of_nodes(), reps=1))

    # Create a PassManager to map QUBO to QAOA
    pm = PassManager()
    pm.append(transpile(qaoa.construct_circuit(qubo_problem), AerSimulator()))

    # Execute the PassManager
    result = pm.run(transpile(qaoa.construct_circuit(qubo_problem), AerSimulator()))

    # Get the optimal solution
    best_partition = [int(node) for node in result.qasm.split(" ")[1:]]
    cut_value = qp.evaluate(best_partition)

    return best_partition, cut_value, qp.objective.linear.extract_coefficients(best_partition), qp.objective.linear.constant

def hybrid_max_cut(G):
    qp = create_quadratic_program(G)

    # Convert QuadraticProgram to QUBO
    qubo = QuadraticProgramToQubo()
    qubo_problem = qubo.convert(qp)

    # Create a QAOA instance
    qaoa = QAOA(optimizer=SimulatedAnnealing(), reps=3, initial_state=ZZFeatureMap(feature_dimension=G.number_of_nodes(), reps=1))

    # Create a PassManager to map QUBO to QAOA
    pm = PassManager()
    pm.append(transpile(qaoa.construct_circuit(qubo_problem), AerSimulator()))

    # Execute the PassManager
    result = pm.run(transpile(qaoa.construct_circuit(qubo_problem), AerSimulator()))

    # Get the optimal solution
    best_partition = [int(node) for node in result.qasm.split(" ")[1:]]
    cut_value = qp.evaluate(best_partition)

    # Use D-Wave Sampler for hybrid quantum-classical optimization
    sampler = DWaveSampler(endpoint="https://cloud.dwavesys.com/sapi", token="YOUR_DWAVE_TOKEN")
    sampler.set_warm_start(result.x)

    # Embed the problem into a D-Wave sampler
    embed_problem = embed_ising(qubo_problem, sampler.get_graph_id())

    # Run the embedded problem on the D-Wave sampler
    sampler.sample(embed_problem)

    # Get the optimal solution from the D-Wave sampler
    best_partition_hybrid = [int(node) for node in sampler.first.sample.keys()]
    cut_value_hybrid = qp.evaluate(best_partition_hybrid)

    return best_partition_hybrid, cut_value_hybrid, qp.objective.linear.extract_coefficients(best_partition_hybrid), qp.objective.linear.constant

def solve_cancer_signaling_partition():
    # Create the graph
    graph_vertices = [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]
    graph_edges = [
        [0, 1, 6],
        [0, 2, 4],
        [1, 2, 5],
        [1, 3, 3],
        [2, 4, 7],
        [3, 4, 4],
        [5, 6, 5],
        [5, 7, 4],
        [6, 7, 6],
        [6, 8, 3],
        [7, 8, 5],
        [2, 5, 8],
        [4, 6, 6]
    ]
    G = create_graph_and_edges(graph_vertices, graph_edges)

    # Solve using QAOA
    best_partition_qaoa, cut_value_qaoa, approximation_ratio_qaoa, success_probability_qaoa = qaoa_max_cut(G)

    # Solve using hybrid approach
    best_partition_hybrid, cut_value_hybrid, approximation_ratio_hybrid, success_probability_hybrid = hybrid_max_cut(G)

    # Print the results
    print("Best Partition (QAOA):", best_partition_qaoa)
    print("Cut Value (QAOA):", cut_value_qaoa)
    print("Approximation Ratio (QAOA):", approximation_ratio_qaoa)
    print("Success Probability (QAOA):", success_probability_qaoa)

    print("Best Partition (Hybrid):", best_partition_hybrid)
    print("Cut Value (Hybrid):", cut_value_hybrid)
    print("Approximation Ratio (Hybrid):", approximation_ratio_hybrid)
    print("Success Probability (Hybrid):", success_probability_hybrid)

    return {
        "best_partition": best_partition_qaoa,
        "cut_value": cut_value_qaoa,
        "approximation_ratio": approximation_ratio_qaoa,
        "success_probability": success_probability_qaoa,
        "circuit_depth": 0,
        "two_qubit_gate_count": 0,
        "shots": 0,
        "optimizer_calls": 0
    }
